title: Sancti spiritus adsit nobis (Anonymous, In honorem sancti spiritus)
desc: Anonymous, attributed to Gaspar van Weerbeke, In honorem sancti spiritus, Sancti spiritus adsit nobis. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0303e.2), edited by Andrea Lindmayr-Brandl (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. III. The Motet Cycles, 1998); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 1994, Lindmayr-Brandl, Andrea. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
